name: Cam Stream
author: Tom Davenport
description: Stream or record the Omarchy desktop you already use—no OBS scene required. Cam Stream keeps its low-latency camera preview as a normal movable, resizable window, captures a focused monitor, window, or region, and sends the capture to X Live Studio or a custom RTMP(S) endpoint, with keyring-protected stream keys and a local copy enabled by default.

barWidget.description: Control a movable, low-latency camera window; record a monitor, window, or region; or send the selected capture to X or RTMP(S).
